note: KDWP state fishing lake (135 acres) in 442 acres of tallgrass prairie and wooded draws, 13 miles north of Emporia off K-99. Primitive camping only in the designated areas: gravel spots off the lake roads, including the shelter-house camping area on the southeast shore where the Clinton Eubank Memorial trail starts (pit toilet and a 1960s stone shelter there). One boat ramp on the north shore, fishing piers. No swimming, no alcohol, no off-road vehicles or horses. --Claude

flags: PHONE missing (apply.py doesn't write it): propose 620-699-3372 (Manager Joe Daniels on the KDWP page; Google lists no phone).

WATERFRONT 'lakeview' kept. The pin is a small gravel turnaround loop at the tip of the west-shore peninsula road, its east edge 10-20 m of open gravel/grass from the water, wooded on the north side - if that turnaround is a designated camping spot it could be LAKEFRONT (lead, not confirmed: the page doesn't map the camping areas). The shelter-house camping area on the SE shore (38.5424,-96.0578) is grass under oaks 20-40 m back from the water with two fishing piers, filtered view = lakeview. The lake holds water on current imagery (no sign it goes dry).

SHELTER-HOUSE CAMPING AREA: ~650 m SE of the pin across the water (about 1.5 km by the lake road over the dam), on the same lake road system and the same entrance - under ~1 km apart and not its own campground, so NOT a split candidate. The other 'primitive campgrounds' are not named or mapped on the page (no brochure on Wayback; live KDWP 403).
HOOKUPS left as stored (derived): the page says 'primitive campgrounds' but never says 'no hookups'; nothing contradicts electric 0.

IRON RANGERS: the page lists two 'Iron Ranger' fee boxes (38.54057,-96.07572 and 38.54993,-96.06252) although KDWP says camping costs nothing; likely for daily hunt permits or donations - not a camping fee on any page I read.
